newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Five dead in tour bus collision in Brazil.
newsitem.headline: Five dead in tour bus collision in Brazil.

text.p: At least five people died when a tour bus collided with other vehicles on a main Sao Paulo highway, police said on Friday.

An undetermined number of people were injured in the crash, which involved the bus, four trucks and 10 cars, police said. The accident occurred late on Thursday near the town of Louveira, 45 miles (75 km) northeast of Sao Paulo.
It was not immediately clear if any passengers on the tour bus were among the dead. The collision took place on highway Bandeirantes, which links the city of Sao Paulo to the state's interior.
